description: This file defines the LDAPUserSyncAPI class, which provides API endpoints for synchronizing LDAP users within the OrangeHRM system. It handles LDAP sync requests, retrieves sync status, and manages related configurations.

classes.name: LDAPUserSyncAPI
classes.description: API class providing LDAP user synchronization endpoints such as initiating sync and retrieving sync status.

methods.name: getLDAPSyncService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LDAPSyncService instance used for LDAP sync operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles LDAP user sync requests; starts synchronization process, records sync status, and returns the sync status model.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the latest LDAP sync status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the create (sync initiation) endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving sync status.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented - would fetch all LDAP sync records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented - would delete LDAP sync records.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Not implemented - would update LDAP sync records.
